versions.content: Handling if EthSwt_MacSecUpdateSecY is called and up- date of a MAC security entity configuration and the establishment of a transmit secure channel was already successfully finalized Status: DRAFT If EthSwt_MacSecUpdateSecY is called and the following conditions are valid: • EthSwtPortMacSecEnabled is available and set to TRUE of the EthSwtPort identified with the given SwitchPortIdx at the EthSwtConfig identified with the given SwitchIdx • the Ethernet switch port was already successfully updated with of a MAC security entity configuration given with MACsecCfgPtr • the establishment of a transmit secure channel with the given TxSci was already successfully finalized then the EthSwt driver shall consider to update the Ethernet switch port that corre- sponds to the given SwitchPortIdx at the Ethernet switch that corresponds to the given SwitchIdx with the MAC security entity configuration provided via MACsec- CfgPtr and return with E_OK .
